title: KTR accuses Congress, BJP of neglecting Telangana farmers’, seeks pending Rythu Bandhu dues, drought relief

ai.summary: BRS leader KTR accused Congress and BJP of neglecting Telangana farmers amid drought, demanding release of pending Rythu Bandhu dues and drought relief.

facts.claim: BRS working president K.T. Rama Rao accused the Congress government in Telangana and the BJP-led Central government of neglecting distressed farmers and failing to provide relief amid drought conditions in the State.
facts.quote: BRS working president K.T. Rama Rao accused the Congress government in Telangana and the BJP-led Central government of neglecting distressed farmers and failing to provide relief amid drought conditions in the State.

facts.claim: He accused the government of deliberately neglecting major irrigation projects. Though the Palamuru-Ranga Reddy Lift Irrigation Project was nearly 90% complete, it had been stalled, while the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project (KLIP) was also being neglected, he alleged.
facts.quote: He accused the government of deliberately neglecting major irrigation projects. Though the Palamuru-Ranga Reddy Lift Irrigation Project was nearly 90% complete, it had been stalled, while the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project (KLIP) was also being neglected, he alleged.

facts.claim: He demanded that the State government immediately release all four pending instalments of Rythu Bandhu.
facts.quote: He demanded that the State government immediately release all four pending instalments of Rythu Bandhu.

facts.claim: He also sought monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 for 36 months, amounting to ₹36,000, for every agricultural labourer who had lost livelihood due to drought.
facts.quote: He also sought monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 for 36 months, amounting to ₹36,000, for every agricultural labourer who had lost livelihood due to drought.

ai.background_note: KTR is demanding immediate release of pending Rythu Bandhu dues and drought relief for Telangana farmers amid drought conditions.
